note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a TUR 12, 14; A06b TUR 12, 14; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships (with major exceptions); a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Turkmenistan, 2024
sources.said: Person has been habitually resident for 5 years. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required (unless person is a Russian citizen (bilateral treaty)). ... n.a.
